firstTimeUser.output:
1. This screen wants me to look at which of two ways of paying my debts costs less, and then finish.

2. I would tap **Done. Back to home.**

3. Words or phrases I did not understand or that felt like tech talk:
- "Highest interest first" and "Smallest debt first". I can guess, but I'm not sure.
- "Yearly interest rate"
- "Balance"
- "Interest you pay", which I think means the extra money, but I'm not certain.
- "Extra each month". Is that on top of the minimum?
- "Which debt goes first". Underneath it are only months, so I can't tell which one goes first.
- "There is no Send button on this page. Your numbers are worked out here." I don't know what "worked out here" means.
- "Show your debts and how each month works"
- "Save a copy", "saved as a file", and "Print opens a preview"
- "Close the print box"
- "Estimate"
- "What the words mean". It's closed, so I don't know what's inside.

4. Things that made me worry:
- "Done. Back to home." I can't tell whether my numbers will be erased. I'd also like to know if I can come back.
- "Start over" and "Remove the last debt". I might wipe something by accident, though the screen says it asks first.
- "Save a copy" puts a file on my phone. I don't know where it goes or who can see it.
- Debt 1 gets paid off in month 6 under one plan and month 22 under the other. I wasn't sure which plan I should follow.
- The "All you pay" totals of $7,575.57 and $7,450.43 are much more than the $5,800 I owe. That's a lot of interest.
- The screen says this is only an estimate, so I don't know how far I can trust it.
- I'm not sure my numbers stay private, even though it says nothing is sent.

5. I would skip:
- The two notes about Remove and Start over.
- The "Keep your answer if you want" part, with Print and Save a copy.
- The "Add another debt" and "Remove the last debt" buttons, since I only have two debts.
- The long explanation of each button.
- Probably the closed section "Show your debts and how each month works".

6. Score: 4. I know I should tap the orange button, but I'm unsure which plan the screen wants me to pick and what happens to my numbers.

firstTimeUser.output:
1. This screen wants me to type in what I owe on my debts, then tap the button to see which way of paying them off is better.

2. I would tap the first box, "Debt 1 name (optional)", since the cursor is already there. After filling things in, I'd tap "Show my answer".

3. Words that felt like tech talk or unclear:
- "Debt Payoff Planner" is fine, but "payoff orders" is odd.
- "Yearly interest rate" (I know interest, but not sure which number on my bill that is)
- "Minimum payment" (fine, but "payment due" might be a different number)
- "Balance"
- "Estimate"
- "Send button" (confusing that it mentions something that isn't there)
- "Your numbers are worked out here" (here where? On my phone? Somewhere else?)
- "How the two payoff orders compare"
- "Highest interest first"
- "What the words mean" (I'd guess it is a help section)
- "Remove asks first and shows which debt goes. Put it back undoes it." (I don't see a "Put it back" button yet)

4. Worries:
- Typing my real debt numbers. The page says there is no Send button and numbers are worked out here, which helps, but I can't fully tell if it's saved or shared.
- "Remove the last debt" sounds like it could delete something, though it says it asks first.
- I don't know if I'm supposed to fill in every box or if blank ones cause trouble.
- It's a long page of boxes, and I might type a number in the wrong one.
- Whether the answer is reliable enough to act on. It says it's only an estimate.
- No cost is mentioned, so I assume it's free, but it never says so.

5. Skippable:
- "Remove the last debt" and its note, since I have nothing to remove yet.
- "How the two payoff orders compare / Your answer shows here" is just a placeholder.
- The "Any name you like" line repeated under each name box.

6. Score: 4. I know to start at the top and tap "Show my answer" at the end, but I'm unsure whether I must fill every box and what happens to my numbers.
